purpose: Read one Health Connect page of one record type's Change Cycle from a held changes token, with its upserted records projected through project-source-record, as ordered Source Retractions and Source Projections with a tentative next token, the instant that keeps the token's continuity provable, and whether more pages remain; or an expired token, a page-level projection refusal, a missing permission, or a read failure, none of which advances the token. The reader claims no durable progress.

inputs.name: record_type
inputs.description: One record type name from project-source-record's PROJECTION_SCHEMA_VERSIONS, such as steps.

inputs.name: change_cycle_identity
inputs.description: The lowercase UUID of the Change Cycle the page belongs to, used as the Wire Protocol cycle_id.

inputs.name: changes_token
inputs.description: The record type's changes token: the pre-read token issued when its Initial or Reconciliation Snapshot began, or the next token a previous change page returned.

inputs.name: unread_since
inputs.description: An instant no later than the logging of any change the token has not yet returned: the time read before the pre-read token was requested, or the next unread-since instant a previous change page returned.

inputs.name: projection_context
inputs.description: The project-source-record ProjectionContext for the Polling Run: the projection-implementation version and the Health Connect provider version, supplied by the caller.

inputs.name: current_time
inputs.description: The time read once from the supplied clock before any Health Connect call.

inputs.name: permission_state
inputs.description: The Health Connect permissions granted to the Sender, read through the access seam immediately before and immediately after the change read.

inputs.name: health_connect_changes
inputs.description: The upsertions, deletions, next token, and continuation flag that Health Connect returns for the token, covering every data origin.

outputs.name: change_page
outputs.description: The record type, Change Cycle identity, and projection-schema version; the page's items in order, every Source Retraction identity before every Source Projection's exact bytes; the tentative next token and its unread-since instant; and whether Health Connect reports more pages.

outputs.name: token_expired
outputs.description: A named reason the token can no longer prove continuity with the change stream, so the caller abandons the attempt or begins a Reconciliation Snapshot.

outputs.name: page_projection_refusal
outputs.description: The first project-source-record refusal on the page, carrying only its failure name, record type, and JSON path, so the caller can block the type with reason projection-refusal at the unchanged token.

outputs.name: not_permitted
outputs.description: Which required permission was missing, read or history, or that Health Connect denied the read, with no page and no token change.

outputs.name: read_failure
outputs.description: One named read failure with no exception text, page, or token change, which the caller reports as failed with reason read-failed and retries on a later run.

observable_effects.name: health-connect-read
observable_effects.description: Reads granted permissions twice and one change page once from Health Connect; never writes, updates, or deletes Health Connect data, never requests a changes token, and never requests a permission or route consent.

owns: the Health Connect change read for one page and the validation of its response
the changes-token age limit and the unread-since instant that keeps a token's continuity provable when Health Connect deletes old change logs without expiring the token
the order of a page's items: every Source Retraction before every Source Projection, each in Health Connect's order, with one retraction per identity
page completeness: every upserted record is projected, or the whole page is refused
the full-history and read permission requirements for a change page read
classification of Health Connect read errors and expiry into the named failures
does_not_own: issuing changes tokens and recording the instant read before each request, which belong to begin-initial-snapshot and begin-reconciliation-snapshot

Change Cycle identity issuance, scheduling, retry, Projection Refusal identity and blocking, permission-gap pauses, and the response to an expired token, which belong to coordinate-sender-sync, begin-initial-snapshot, and begin-reconciliation-snapshot
persisting tokens and unread-since instants, staging Outbox Messages, encryption, and fragmentation, which belong to stage-outbox-batch
Change Completion, which belongs to stage-sync-completion
snapshot pages and positions, which belong to read-snapshot-page
the projection of each record, which belongs to project-source-record
applying retractions and ordering source evidence at the Portal, which belong to reconcile-source-record
requesting permissions, background-read eligibility, and feature availability
exposing the reader to the TypeScript shell through the Expo module
